label: ABB YuMi arm (IRB 14000)
license: Apache-2.0 (abb_robot_client); EGM is a paid ABB option
realtime: UDP to the controller at up to 250 Hz; a dedicated link is advised
note: IRC5 with RobotWare 6 only (the client does not support RobotWare 7), the EGM option and a RAPID program in EGMRunJoint. Joint order is axes 1, 2, 7, 3, 4, 5, 6; the mapping onto EGM is unverified on a real YuMi. Home is the calibration pose. Grippers are not driven.
